oligos.indication: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) in adults with a SOD1 mutation
oligos.design_source: FDA QALSODY label NDA215887 sec 11 DESCRIPTION; EMA Qalsody EPAR EMA/276404/2024 sec 2.4.1.1
oligos.notes: 20-base residue 5-10-5 MOE gapmer mixed-backbone ASO; of 19 internucleotide linkages 15 are 3'-O to 5'-O phosphorothioate diesters and 4 are 3'-O to 5'-O phosphate diesters (FDA label sec 11). Molecular formula C230H317N72O123P19S15, MW 7127.86 amu. Cytosine and uridine bases methylated at the 5-position. Sequence transcribed from the shorthand printed in EMA EPAR EMA/276404/2024 sec 2.4.1.1: 5'-MeCsAoGsGoAsTsAsMeCsAsTsTsTsMeCsTsAsMeCoAsGoMeCsMeU-3' (s = phosphorothioate, o = phosphodiester; MeC = 5-methylcytosine, MeU = 5-methyluridine). Case convention applied here: uppercase = 2'-MOE wing, lowercase = DNA gap; equals CAGGATACATTTCTACAGCT in DNA-base convention (MeU is T-equivalent). IT dose 100 mg (15 mL) per administration.

oligos.indication: spinal muscular atrophy (SMA), paediatric and adult
oligos.design_source: FDA SPINRAZA label NDA209531 sec 11 DESCRIPTION; EMA Spinraza EPAR EMA/289068/2017 sec 2.2.2
oligos.notes: Uniformly modified 2'-MOE phosphorothioate ASO, 18 nucleotide residues, printed in EMA EPAR EMA/289068/2017 sec 2.2.2 as 5'-MeU MeC A MeC MeU MeU MeU MeC A MeU A A MeU G MeC MeU G G-3'; same document states 17 phosphorothioate diester internucleotide linkages. All residues MOE-modified so all uppercase. Equivalent DNA-base rendering TCACTTTCATAATGCTGG. Molecular formula C234H323N61O128P17S17Na17, MW 7501.0 Da (FDA label sec 11). Two approved IT regimens: 12 mg loading/12 mg maintenance (Low Dose Regimen) and 50 mg loading/28 mg maintenance (High Dose Regimen).

CONFLICTS BETWEEN SOURCES - ALL FLAGGED ON THE ROWS THEMSELVES
A. TOFERSEN myelitis/radiculitis counts. US label sec 5.1: 'Six patients ... experienced myelitis or radiculitis'
   (combined). EU SmPC sec 4.8: 6 serious myelitis (4.1%) PLUS 2 serious radiculitis (1.4%) = 8. EMA EPAR
   Table 37 (same pool, cut-off 28 Feb 2023): myelitis 4/147 (2.7%) and radiculitis 4/147 (2.7%) as ADRs of any
   severity. Three mutually inconsistent renderings; all three are recorded as separate readouts so the
   disagreement is visible. Different data cut-offs are the likely explanation but this is NOT stated anywhere.
B. TOFERSEN papilledema/ICP discontinuation. US label sec 5.2: 'no events led to discontinuation of QALSODY'.
   EU SmPC sec 4.8: 'One reaction finally led to permanent discontinuation of tofersen, one reaction led to
   interruption'. Direct contradiction.
C. NUSINERSEN monkey neurobehaviour. US label sec 8.4: 'possible neurobehavioral deficits were observed on a
   learning and memory test at the high dose in the 53-week monkey study'. EMA EPAR sec 2.3.4: 'There were no
   treatment-related effects on neurobehavioral or learning parameters.' Both filed, as a grade-2 row and a
   grade-0 row respectively.
D. NUSINERSEN pre/postnatal mouse neurobehaviour. US label sec 8.1 reports adverse offspring neurobehavioural
   effects (locomotor activity, learning and memory) at ALL doses of 1.4/5.8/17.2 mg/kg with no no-effect level
   established. EU SmPC sec 5.3: 'No impact on ... pre/post-natal development was observed'; EPAR sec 2.3.4 calls
   the reproductive studies 'negative for drug-related effects'. The EU documents appear not to have assessed the
   same study. Recorded per the US label with the conflict flagged.
E. NUSINERSEN hippocampal vacuolation interpretation. The US label sec 8.4 calls it 'brain histopathology
   (neuronal vacuolation and necrosis/cellular debris in the hippocampus)'. The EMA EPAR concludes the vacuoles
   are FIXATION-INDUCED artefacts containing drug, absent when tissue is fixed in Carnoy's or Karnovsky's
   fixative, and 'do not represent an adverse histopathological finding'. Both readings are filed (grade-2 rows
   for the finding, a grade-0 row for the fixation-control study). This is a genuine scientific dispute, not a
   transcription error, and it materially affects how the nusinersen hippocampal rows should be modelled.
F. TOFERSEN 13-week monkey NOAEL is printed in EMA EPAR sec 2.5.4.2 as '12 mg/kg'. Every other monkey IT dose in
   the same document and in SmPC sec 5.3 is an absolute mg per injection (4, 12, 35 mg), so '/kg' is treated here
